message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Tests

on:
  pull_request:
  push:

jobs:
  run:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.8", "3.9", "3.10", "3.11"]
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-10.15]
      fail-fast: false

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Setup Micromamba Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: mamba-org/setup-micromamba@v1
      with:
        environment-name: TEST
        init-shell: bash
        create-args: >-
          python=${{ matrix.python-version }} --file requirements.txt --file requirements-dev.txt --channel conda-forge

    - name: Install GFortran macOS
      if: contains(matrix.os, 'macos')
      # available gfotran are: 8, 9, and 10 (latest)
      run: |
        ln -s /usr/local/bin/gfortran-10 /usr/local/bin/gfortran
        which gfortran

    - name: Cache pip dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/pip
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

    - name: Install pywafo
      shell: bash -l {0}
      run: |
        python -m pip install -e . --no-deps --force-reinstall

    - name: Tests
      shell: bash -l {0}
      run: |
        pytest -s -rxs -v src",
  "rationale": "The workflow reinstalls dependencies (micromamba conda environment plus `pip install -e .`) on every matrix job with no dependency cache, so repeated dependency fetching dominates runtime. The repository has pyproject.toml, satisfying the cache-input precondition, and no equivalent cache already exists. Adding actions/cache@v4 for ~/.cache/pip keyed on pyproject.toml (with restore-keys) reuses downloaded/built Python packages across runs without changing any build or test step, preserving full matrix coverage. This matches the evidenced pip-dependency-cache change; fail-fast was rejected because it would reduce matrix diagnostic coverage, and a custom timeout was rejected because the CI history contains only failures, not representative successful durations.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2"]
}
